about: Propose a new feature or enhancement

## Feature Summary

> Provide a clear and concise description of the feature you are requesting.

<!-- Example: "Add ability for users to export their dashboard data as a CSV file." -->


## Problem / Motivation

> What problem does this feature solve? Why is it needed? Describe the context and use case.

**As a** [type of user],
**I want** [some goal],
**So that** [some benefit].


## Proposed Solution

> Describe your proposed solution. How should it work? Include UI mockups, API designs, or examples if relevant.


## Alternatives Considered

> Have you considered alternative solutions? Why were they rejected?


## Acceptance Criteria

> Define what "done" looks like. These will form the basis of the test cases.

- [ ] Criteria 1
- [ ] Criteria 2
- [ ] Criteria 3


## Additional Context

> Add any other relevant context, screenshots, or links here.

- Related issue(s): #
- Related PR(s): #
- External references:


## Checklist (for maintainers)

- [ ] Feature aligns with project scope and roadmap
- [ ] Acceptance criteria are clear and testable
- [ ] Assigned to a milestone
- [ ] Labelled correctly
